articles.summary: One of Nebraska's newest software companies looks and sounds like a startup, and it tends to act like one. It's got five young developer employees. Its products are mobile-based and innovative like a lot of startups. Its website looks like any other. The team practices lean principals. But there's something inherently different about Valvora, a software as a service company focusing on human relations and management solutions, among other things.
articles.title: The Startup That Grew From Inside a 152-year-old Fortune 150 Company
